text: Being here, I am struck by the sense of anticipation and collaborative energy in the air. The glass room, people conversing, and a display dedicated to R+D (Research and Development) fill me with a subtle curiosity. It feels as though I am at the threshold of innovation, witnessing minds meet, ideas exchange, and potential emerge. I am both observer and participant, awash in the purposeful atmosphere of collective creativity. Something meaningful feels possible here.
